## Sheet

- **Player.** Lena.
- **Class, species and level.** Cleric (Life Domain) 3, Human, Hermit background.
- **Armor Class, Hit Points and Speed.** AC 17 (scale mail and shield), 24 Hit Points, Speed 30 ft.
- **Passive Perception and save DC.** Passive Perception 13. Spell save DC 13, spell attack +5.
- **Saving throws.** Wisdom +5, Charisma +3, Strength +0, Dexterity +1, Constitution +2, Intelligence +0.

| Str     | Dex     | Con     | Int     | Wis     | Cha     |
| ------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ------- |
| 10 (+0) | 12 (+1) | 14 (+2) | 10 (+0) | 17 (+3) | 12 (+1) |

### Features

- **Spellcasting.** Wisdom is her spellcasting ability. She has 4 level 1 slots and 2 level 2 slots.
- **Divine Order (Protector).** Proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Heavy armor.
- **Channel Divinity.** Two uses. Divine Spark and Turn Undead, and the Life option Preserve Life.
- **Preserve Life.** Heal 15 Hit Points, divided among creatures within 30 feet, up to half their maximum.
- **Disciple of Life.** Healing spells restore extra Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell's level.
- **Human traits.** Resourceful (Heroic Inspiration after a Long Rest), Skillful and Versatile.
- **Healer.** From her Hermit background. Battle Medic with a healer's kit, and healing dice reroll 1s.
- **Musician.** From Versatile. After a Short or Long Rest she can give Heroic Inspiration to allies who hear her hymn.
- **Skills.** Insight +5, Medicine +5, Religion +2, Persuasion +3.

## Spells

- **Cantrips.** Guidance, Sacred Flame, Spare the Dying.
- **Always prepared (Life Domain).** Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration.
- **Prepared.** Command, Detect Magic, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word, Shield of Faith, Spiritual Weapon.

## Inventory

- Scale mail and a shield with the mark of [[Mother Ebb]].
- Mace, a healer's kit and a priest's pack.
- A reed and a river stone on a cord, worn as a holy symbol.
- The [[Harbormaster's Ledger of Vessen]], wrapped in oilcloth.
- 18 gold pieces.

## Story

> [!narration] Portrait
> You are a lean woman with a shaved head and deep brown eyes that look at you a moment too long. The blue cloth of your order is faded almost to grey, and a stain of salt runs around the hem. Your voice is low and sure. You hold your hands open when you talk, as if offering something.

### Backstory

Odalys was raised at the shrine of Mother Ebb in a river town upstream. She took her vows at nineteen and was sent south to Saltwick to serve the marsh people. On her first night she asked why the shrine had no bell, and the senior priest told her to stop asking. She did not.

## Goals and bonds

- **Goal.** Learn why the shrines of [[Mother Ebb]] have no bells, and whether the silence hides something.
- **Bond.** Her order, and [[Nib Ashwater]], who took her to see the names of the dead.
- **Fear.** That the church's silence covered a crime, and that she has served it without knowing.

## Plans

- The church stopped ringing bells after the flood of 271 CY. Use a Spotlight when the senior priest at the Saltwick shrine learns of the ledger and asks Odalys to bring it to him.
- Odalys can speak the names of the drowned at the next Long Ebb, and that would settle [[The Silent Bell]].
